foreground: Visible identifiable loads, cartons, crates and stored or transported goods, including loads on shelves or robots
background: Robot bodies, shelf structure, floor, walls, people, transport equipment, empty pallets and empty handling containers
uncertainty: Mark ambiguous identity, occlusion boundaries and unresolvable pixels as ignore; do not infer hidden surfaces or unseen container contents
reference_limitations: Corrections start from AI-assisted drafts and can retain anchoring bias. Counts are pilot requirements, not statistical adequacy guarantees. Human attestation is not automatic accuracy certification.
test_policy: Do not prepare or use held-out test labels until the candidate and evaluation protocol are frozen
